ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel field with a macro-ratio of approximately 95:5 relative to high-intensity (white) scarred areas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity base color; spatial mapping reveals high-contrast white linear clusters distributed across both lobes, with a higher density of circular white clusters localized near the proximal median notch and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior pixel angle of 48-52 degrees and a narrow bounding-box width-to-depth ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire continuous linear boundary; distinct pixel-amplitude peaks are visible on the outer third of the left lobe and the inner third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edge (outer boundary) follows a convex trajectory toward the distal tips, while the trailing edge exhibits a primarily concave curve with localized jagged irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, roughly circular white pixel clusters (2-8 pixels diameter) concentrated on the upper peripheral region of the left lobe and scattered across the medial right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High detection of unaligned linear pixel disruptions; includes a prominent 45-degree diagonal white scratch on the mid-left lobe and multiple intersecting horizontal rake marks on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive multi-directional linear rake marks and significant irregular pixel-loss/wear at the distal fluke tips consistent with physical trauma or abrasion.
